cards.review_notes: The official search-indexed camp page includes a 2027 permission form but retains an introductory reference to the 2025 online form. Confirm that the embedded registration form is for 2027. June 4 is explicitly a payment deadline, not an explicitly stated application deadline. Arrival is no later than 15:00 June 7; campers leave after the June 10 ceremony beginning at 10:30. The eligibility wording is rising grades 4–12 '(or who is 17yrs old)'. Venue address remains unresolved: third-party listings give 265 or 267 Camp Joshua Lane and 90 Stanley Lane; the operator identifies 90 Stanley Lane as its main office, while the venue's own readable indexed contact page supplies no street address. Confirm the camper drop-off address.
